# Illucrum

> Illucrum provides specialized SEO audits for SaaS, E-commerce, and general websites, as well as standalone Technical SEO Audits.

## Core Services & Products

- [SaaS SEO Audit](https://illucrum.com/audits/saas-seo-audit): SEO audit tailored specifically for B2B and B2C SaaS platforms.
- [E-commerce SEO Audit](https://illucrum.com/audits/ecommerce-seo-audit/): Comprehensive SEO audit designed for online stores and catalog architecture.
- [General SEO Audit](https://illucrum.com/audits/seo-audit): All-around SEO audit for general websites and businesses.
- [Technical SEO Audit](https://illucrum.com/audits/technical-seo-audit): Specialized single-tier audit focused strictly on technical performance, crawlability, and indexing.

## Audit Documentation & Breakdown

Markdown source files detailing every specific check and point evaluated in each audit type:

- [E-commerce Audit Breakdown](https://illucrum.com/static/md/ecommerce_audit.txt): Complete point-by-point checklist for E-commerce SEO audits.
- [SaaS Audit Breakdown](https://illucrum.com/static/md/saas_audit.txt): Complete point-by-point checklist for SaaS SEO audits.
- [General Website Audit Breakdown](https://illucrum.com/static/md/website_audit.txt): Complete point-by-point checklist for general SEO audits.
- [Technical Audit Breakdown](https://illucrum.com/static/md/technical_audit.txt): Complete point-by-point checklist for Technical-only SEO audits.

## Free tool

There is one free tool, a bulk SEO checker. You enter up to 25 URLs, and it checks their meta tags, headings, alt texts, word count, canonical links, OG tags and schema.
Fetches the HTML through a simple relay, and performs the checks in the browser. We don't collect any data about the usage of the tool, we don't store the results anywhere. But you can download the results in CSV format.
 - [Bulk SEO Checker](https://illucrum.com/tools/bulk-checker/): the tool itself
 - [About the meta tags check](https://illucrum.com/tools/bulk-checker/meta-tag-check/)
 - [About the headings check](https://illucrum.com/tools/bulk-checker/heading-check/)
 - [About the alt text check](https://illucrum.com/tools/bulk-checker/alt-text-check/)
 - [About the word count check](https://illucrum.com/tools/bulk-checker/word-count-check/)
 - [About the canonical links check](https://illucrum.com/tools/bulk-checker/canonical-check/)
 - [About the OG tags check](https://illucrum.com/tools/bulk-checker/open-graph-check/)
 - [About the schema check](https://illucrum.com/tools/bulk-checker/schema-check/)
